ko: [Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]우리 부족은 한동안 매우 부유했던 시절이 있었어.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]그 뒤의 한 마디는 이 말이지.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]우리 보물 찾으러 가요. 지하에 묻힌 보물을 발견할지 누가 알아요!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]그, 그래도 돼? 돈이 있으면, 난……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]네, 저도 그렇게 생각해요. 그리고 그 뿔 엄청 세잖아요!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]그러면 하고 싶은 일이 생긴 거잖아!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]슈퍼 울트라 킹갓 뿔에 엠퍼러 제네럴 마제스티급 꼬리가 달린 엄청 완전 짱예쁜 공주님처럼!
en: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=1)]*pant*... Phew...
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]You girls ever hear that story for kids?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]'The King Who Went from the Wasteland'.
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]I did!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Um, I know that one too.
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Way back when, our tribe was real rich.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Right, it mentions that at the end.
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]'The path to riches leads to the mountain jungles.'
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Our ancestors had a whole lot of money!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]We should go treasure hunting! Maybe there's treasure buried underground!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Can we actually? If I had money, then I'd...
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Is this about your horns again?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Seriously, your horns are—
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]*whimper*... Don't!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]C'mon, they're super cool!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]I'm sorry!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]Huh?
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]Wait... What did you say?
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]'C'mon, they're super cool!'
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Yeah, I think so too. They're so... powerful!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]R-Really?
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]Just think of all the enemies you could knock over!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]And I've got all these little accessories that I'm sure would look great on you~
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]Well, there you go, something you'd wanna do!
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]If you had a buttload of cash, just buy all that stuff!
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]Mm-hm... mm-hm!
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]You'll be as pretty as a princess~
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]Y-You think?
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]A Super-Awesome Mighty-Invincible Two-Horned Spiral-Tailed Pretty Princess!
ja: [Title] MAIN_LOG_104_1
[Div] Part.02
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=1)]フゥ……フゥ……
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]お前らあの童話を知ってるか？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]「王は荒野から出発した」ってやつ……
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]知ってます！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]うん、私も知ってる……
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]アタシたちの部族は、昔すげー豊かな時期があったんだぜ。
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]確か童話の後半に……
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]「富の道は山と森にまで届き――」ってあったよね。
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]私たちの祖先はお金持ちだったんですね！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]地下にお宝が埋まってるかもしれません、宝探しに行きませんか！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]本当に？　もしお金があれば、私は……
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]お前また角のこと言う気か？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]正直、お前の角ってさ……
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]ううっ……！　やめて！
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]超カッケーよな！！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]ごめんなさいっ！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]え？
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]今……何て？
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]お前の角、超カッケーつったんだよ！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]はい、私もそう思います。とってもすごいです！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]ほ、本当に？
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]あんなに敵を倒したじゃないですか！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]それに、私が持ってるアクセサリーなんかで飾れば、きっと素敵になりますよ〜
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]やりたいことが見つかったじゃねぇか！
[Dialog(head="char_187_ccheal", delay=0.5)]金持ちになったら、アクセサリーを買えばいいだろ！
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=1)]う……うん！
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]きっとお姫様みたいにキレイですよ〜
[Dialog(head="char_127_estell", delay=0.5)]お姫様みたいに？
[Dialog(head="char_411_tomimi", delay=0.5)]ええ。スーパーストロングホーンビーストローリングサンダーロングテールプリティプリンセスです！
